newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian man blows himself up over unpaid wages.
newsitem.headline: Russian man blows himself up over unpaid wages.

text.p: An employee of a power station in the Russian Far East blew himself up with a home-made bomb because he had not been paid for many months, Interfax news agency said on Thursday.
The man died on the spot after detonating the device in front of the offices of the Primorskaya hydro-electric power plant, Interfax said. Nobody else was hurt.
It said power plant employees had last been paid in March.
Police were not immediately able to confirm the incident.
Millions of Russians have to wait many months for their wages, partly due to a complex web of debts between companies. Many live below the poverty line and struggle to make ends meet.
